ns2:section.sectionText: Classes will meet Fridays 5:30 p.m. -9:20 p.m. and Saturdays 8:00 a.m. - 4:50 p.m. on the following weekends: Jan 17-18, Feb 21-22, Mar 14-15, Apr 11-12, 2014. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
